subject.title: fix(edit): show candidate lines with similarity scores on oldText match failure

question: Should this PR's concise candidate-line diagnostics become the canonical implementation for the edit mismatch diagnostics request, or should maintainers choose a sibling branch such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97269?
rationale: Several open PRs implement the same user-facing edit mismatch output contract, and automation should not choose the final wording and canonical branch while a maintainer has just engaged on this PR.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: After refreshing against main and clearing or triaging QA Smoke CI, land this bounded helper-based implementation and close or rebase the sibling attempts.

options.title: Prefer a sibling PR
options.body: Pause this branch and choose a richer or more current sibling implementation if its output contract better matches the requested diagnostics.

options.title: Request one consolidated branch
options.body: Ask for a final narrow PR that preserves this branch's bounded scoring while adopting any preferred wording or coverage from the sibling attempts.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: After refreshing against main and clearing or triaging QA Smoke CI, land this bounded helper-based implementation and close or rebase the sibling attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and authored the latest compatibility commit on this PR while also having recent edit-diff history.
